hero.title: We all have something within us that wants to become a great story... <highlight>an idea or a memory tied to a distinctive way of seeing the world.</highlight>
hero.description: Storativa helps you turn what inspires you into a work of your own by exploring eras, places, and possibilities.

impulse.title: Impulse
impulse.subtitle: Everything begins with something that moves you
impulse.description: An emotion, a memory, a question, or a concern awakens the desire to tell. Before there is a plot, there is already something that needs to be expressed.

meeting.title: Encounter
meeting.subtitle: The story that sparks your interest
meeting.description: An era, a place, or a historical event becomes the starting point. It is not only about knowing the past, but discovering which part of it has something to tell you.

look.title: Perspective
look.subtitle: Your way of interpreting the world
look.description: The story gains its own perspective. Your questions, experiences, and imagination find a distinctive way of observing what happened and what might have happened.

narrative.title: Narrative
narrative.subtitle: Where the story begins to breathe
narrative.description: Time, place, customs, and characters build a coherent setting. Research provides context; your imagination brings it to life.

tension.title: Tension
tension.subtitle: Every story needs something at stake
tension.description: Desires collide, decisions have consequences, and familiar reality begins to change. In conflict, the story finds its direction and strength.

opus.title: Work
opus.subtitle: A personal vision ready to be shared
opus.description: What began as a concern becomes an authentic narrative: a story that preserves your voice, engages with the past, and can connect with someone else.

conclusion.title: Your story could <highlight>create connections</highlight>
conclusion.description: What begins with an emotion, a memory, or a personal perspective can become a story able to cross eras, awaken new ideas, and connect with those who find something of themselves in it.
